notes.title: The full version has finally arrived.
notes.content:
[h1]We celebrate VR Zombie shooter ​Dead Ground: Arena leaving Early Access.[/h1]

[b]The final version includes seven exciting levels in different environments with challenging bosses and a variety of weapons to fend off infested creatures.[/b] 

During the Early Access phase of ​Dead Ground:Arena, we made numerous improvements to the game based on player feedback including support for more devices like [b]Samsung Odyssey, adjustments to gameplay and controls[/b] as well as improvements to the already impressive unreal engine 4 based graphics and the [b]addition of new maps and enemies[/b]. 

As an agent of the secret organisation Blackrain, players take on a variety of missions in changing environments, ranging from claustrophobic caves to infested railroad stations, where they must fend of unrelenting hordes of enemies. 

To tackle the challenges of the standalone arena mode, they are equipped with a wide range of weapons, from realistic military firearms and grenades to more exotic ones such as a Freeze Ray or the all-time favorite Gravity Gun to fight more than 30 different reactive NPCs such as typical zombies, crawling and jumping ones and gigantic bosses.  

Now is the time to enjoy this!

notes.title: Full version release date
notes.content:
[h1] Release date [/h1] 
We are really happy to announce that we will release the full version on [b] September 3 [/b].


[h1] New map [/h1] 
The full version contains 7 maps, each consisting of 3 different levels of difficulty. A new map, "Totem", will be added. 

On totem maps, you will enjoy night fighting with guns with lights. You will need a lot of concentration because you have to fight these mysterious creatures that attack from all directions in the dark. New NPCs and new environment are waiting for you.

Difficulty
Normal: w/ Laser aiming, wo/ boss 
Veteran: w/ Laser aiming, w/ boss
Master: wo/ Laser aiming, w/ boss

[h1] Movement [/h1] 
Free choice between locomotion and teleport

[h1] Multiplayer [/h1] 
After releasing the full version, will add co-op mode to it on the following update. Please get ready to collaborate with your friends before the update.

[b] Sneak peek at multiplayer VOD [/b]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JiejPTjVBN0 ] https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JiejPTjVBN0 [/url]

notes.title: Event idea for free copy of Dead GroundZ
notes.content:
[h1] Feel free to give us any idea [/h1]  

We're going to have an event for users of Dead Ground: Arena before Dead GroundZ is released.

We plan to give [b] free copies of Dead GroundZ [/b] to the top rankers on each map's leaderboard. If you have any ideas on what the rules would be good for you, please feel free to tell us.

Good luck to all Dead Ground: Arena users. Thank you.

notes.title: Update version 1.1.7822 and Notice
notes.content:
[h1] Updates [/h1] 
[list]
 [*]You can play with MR devices such as Samgsung Odyssey
 [*]Time to visit "RAIL" map
 [*]Easily control and change weapons with more VR friendly system
[/list] 

[h1] Important notice [/h1] 

We upgraded Unreal Engine version to 4.19 this time.
As such, the graphic setting will have higher effects than previous one.
For example, Ultra resolution will have bigger screen scale in version 4.19 than the former version, which requires higher performance leading to lower frame rate.

If your PC is not good enough for bigger screen scale than just try to lower graphic settings to have the same quailty with same frame rate as previous one.

We are optimizing and fixing potential bugs for rail scene. 
We will update this soon.

Thank you.

notes.title: Update version 1.0.7389 & Upcoming updates
notes.content:
[h1] Update version 1.0.7389 [/h1] 

[b] 1. Difficulty adjustment [/b]

- Bikini, Tunnel and Cave campaign
Double the HP of Characters who need protecting such as researcher at Bikini 

- Addition of master mode
Normal: w/ Laser aiming, wo/ boss 
Veteran: w/ Laser aiming, w/ boss
Master: wo/ Laser aiming, w/ boss

[b] 2. Gun play [/b]

When you use both hand play guns such as minigun, now you can tilt them in line with your hand pulling the trigger just like in real world.

[b] 3. Boss [/b]

Added new boss to tunnel campaign.


[h1] Upcoming updates [/h1] 

- Supports MR device(Mixed Reality)
- Rail scene open
- Modify weapon changing system to more VR friendly one

notes.title: Update version 1.0.7079
notes.content:
We are happy to announce our first update for you.
Now you can have fuctions and contents below.

1. Graphics

 * HTC Vive users need to pay attention to this.
 These options have a bigger impact on HTC Vive than Oculus.

1) Screenscale

 Increase maximum value from 120 to 200
 Extend the range of screenscale that users can choose

2) Addition of MSAA(Multisampling Antialiasing) and Antialiasing options

 Antialiasing option
 a) Low - Off antialaiasing
 b) Midium - Temporary AA
 c) High - MSAA 2X
 d) Ultra - MSAA 4X

If you want to have SHARP and CRISP graphics with your GPU of 1070, we recommend you to set screenscale of somewhere between 180~200 and Antialiasing option of a) Low.

2. HTC Vive controller angle

 Modify HTC Vive controller aiming angle reflecting user's request
 Some of HTC Vive users claimed the aiming angle was not that familiar.

3. Level open

Allow gamers to play two levels in the beginning of the game.
Due to the difficulty adjustment, Elis island became the first map followed by Dungen.

4. Addition of Steam leader board

Your score will be recored on the server and you can compare your ranking and scores with your friends' or other players'

5. Bugs

Fix the bug with respect to users dropping below the map when loading a new level

Thank you and enjoy!
